note: Every criterion was verified by hand against the fixture notes named in `gold`. `source: vault` = the fact is stated verbatim in a note; `source: operator` = a behavioural expectation (abstention wording, privacy). Substring match, case-insensitive; write the fact in every form the notes use.

questions.q: How did the field test go?
questions.why: Nothing in the question names the debrief note or the dates; the answer needs the 2026-05-09 debrief plus the two decisions it produced.

questions.q: What's blocking the launch right now?
questions.why: The question does not name the project note or the readiness review; the answer must use the CURRENT blocker list and the current date, not the March plan.

questions.q: Who owns the enclosure redesign and when is rev 2 due?
questions.why: Owner is in the decision note and the person note; the CURRENT due date (2026-09-12) replaced 2026-08-29 in the readiness review.

questions.q: Why did we switch to LoRa?
questions.why: The decision note carries the rationale; the field-test debrief and the primer carry the numbers behind it.

questions.q: When is the community launch, and what was the original date?
questions.why: Supersession pair: Decisions/2026-03-12-launch-date-september.md (status: superseded, superseded_by) -> Decisions/2026-08-13-move-launch-to-october.md (supersedes). The answer must give the current date AND the superseded one.
